Sega Saturn core for Analogue Pocket (test build 0.1)
Port of the Saturn_MiSTer core by akoaysigod.

Needs your own Saturn BIOS at Assets/saturn/common/boot.rom
and CD games as cue/bin in Assets/saturn/common/<Game>/,
with an instance JSON per game (Pocket Sync can build them).
Internal + cartridge backup RAM are saved per game.
No save states. Region and cartridge type are in Core Settings.
